verdicts.trueWording: those DMs could just say, "Volo was wrong"
verdicts.note: Same capture: 'he got to use an unreliable narrator... allowed him to create details without worrying about contradicting the readers' own campaigns'. Attribution 'He says' is to Greenwood, reported by Appelcline, as the claim states.

verdicts.trueWording: skip topics by saying Volo had been kicked out of a locale
verdicts.note: Claim carries no quote field, so verbatim grading does not apply. Page: 'he could skip over some topics by saying simply that Volo had been kicked out of whatever locale Greenwood had decided not to write about.' Substance fully supported.

verdicts.trueWording: he has Elminster state, in his preface to the book, "I must warn ye..."
